name: Merci Archa
source:
Merci Archa is a humble girl from an average town in Helman. She's hard-working, resourceful, and smart. She's also quite a pretty young lady, since she was awarded with beauty prices in the past, and [url=/c97954]Anasel Caspora[/url] considers her to be her rival as a result, which Merci seems entirely unaware of.

While she is quite timid and submissive, she has a surprisingly strong will that allows her to continue to stand through numerous hardships. It is because of this inner strength that [url=/c52688]Patton Misnarge[/url] came to trust her as an invaluable part of his revolution. 

[From [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Merci_Archa]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
